metadata.description: Knowledge Base for Intention-Aware Dataset Grounding

PREDICT.name: PREDICT
PREDICT.purpose: Forecast future outcomes based on historical patterns
PREDICT.description: Extract patterns from past data to make predictions about future events

HC1.name: temporal_column
HC1.description: Table must have temporal column (date, year, timestamp)

HC2.name: outcome_column
HC2.description: Table must have outcome/target column (side effect, symptom, measurement)

HC3.name: explanatory_columns
HC3.description: Table must have at least 2 explanatory columns (features, dimensions)

HC4.name: data_volume
HC4.description: Table must have at least 100 rows for statistical validity

semantic.name: ψ_semantic
semantic.description: Column relevance to prediction domain (0-1 scale)

structural.name: ψ_structural
structural.description: Data types appropriate for prediction (0-1 scale)
structural.evaluation: Average score of: temporal (1.0 if DATE/TIMESTAMP, 0.5 if year, 0), outcome (0.75 if numeric, 0.25 if categorical), explanatory (0.5-1.0 mix)

coverage.name: ψ_coverage
coverage.description: Breadth of columns covering prediction domain (0-1 scale)
coverage.evaluation: Measure: demographics, environment, temporal range, outcome diversity

joinability.name: ψ_joinability
joinability.description: Ability to link with other tables (0-1 scale)
joinability.evaluation: Count joinable columns / potential join opportunities

weights.rationale: PREDICT prioritizes coverage (0.35) and quality (0.25) because forecasting needs complete, accurate feature sets. Joinability is low (0.05) because prediction is typically single-table.

COMPARE.name: COMPARE
COMPARE.purpose: Identify differences between groups or regions
COMPARE.description: Find and quantify differences in outcomes across multiple groups or time periods

HC1.name: grouping_column
HC1.description: Table must have grouping column (region, country, vaccine type, demographic)

HC2.name: measured_outcome
HC2.description: Table must have outcome/measured column (rate, count, percentage)

HC3.name: multi_dimensional_groups
HC3.description: Table must have at least 2 grouping dimensions

HC4.name: group_cardinality
HC4.description: Table must have at least 2 distinct groups per dimension

semantic.name: ψ_semantic
semantic.description: Column relevance to comparison domain (0-1 scale)

structural.name: ψ_structural
structural.description: Group column cardinality and clarity (0-1 scale)
structural.evaluation: Normalized cardinality: actual groups / expected maximum groups

coverage.name: ψ_coverage
coverage.evaluation: Count of distinct outcome measures / expected outcomes

quality.name: ψ_quality
quality.description: Group balance and data consistency (0-1 scale)

joinability.name: ψ_joinability
joinability.description: Ability to align groups across tables (0-1 scale)
joinability.evaluation: Count of group columns that match other tables / total group columns

weights.rationale: COMPARE prioritizes structural clarity (0.30) because meaningful comparison requires clear, distinct groups. Joinability (0.15) matters to validate comparisons across tables.

CORRELATE.name: CORRELATE
CORRELATE.purpose: Find relationships or dependencies between variables
CORRELATE.description: Identify statistical or logical associations between two or more variables

HC1.name: min_variables
HC1.description: Table must have at least 2 numeric/measurable columns

HC2.name: sufficient_rows
HC2.description: Table must have at least 50 rows for correlation validity

HC3.name: variable_variance
HC3.description: Each variable must have meaningful variance (not constant)

SUMMARIZE.name: SUMMARIZE
SUMMARIZE.purpose: Describe current data or compute aggregates
SUMMARIZE.description: Create summaries, overviews, or aggregate statistics from data

HC1.name: aggregatable_columns
HC1.description: Table must have at least 1 column suitable for aggregation

HC2.name: grouping_optional
HC2.description: Table should ideally have grouping columns (not strictly required)

EXPLAIN.name: EXPLAIN
EXPLAIN.description: Find causal or mechanistic explanations for observed phenomena

HC1.name: outcome_column
HC1.description: Table must have a target outcome to explain

HC2.name: feature_columns
HC2.description: Table must have at least 3 potential explanatory features

FILTER.name: FILTER
FILTER.purpose: Select subset of data based on criteria
FILTER.description: Extract rows or records matching specific conditions

HC1.name: filterable_columns
HC1.description: Table must have columns with meaningful values to filter on

JOIN.name: JOIN
JOIN.description: Link tables on common keys to create enriched dataset

HC1.name: join_key
HC1.description: Table must have at least one column that can serve as join key

HC2.name: key_uniqueness
HC2.description: Join key should have reasonable cardinality (not all unique, not all same)

five_axes.description: Data types and cardinality appropriate for action
Ability to link with other tables

framework.balke_foundation: This KB extends Balke (2004) multi-objective ranking by: (1) making weights action-dependent rather than static, (2) adding hard constraints as binary filters before soft scoring, (3) unifying 5 domain-derived axes instead of arbitrary objectives, (4) storing specifications in a queryable KB that grows with novel actions.

metadata_extended.kb_growth_strategy: Phase 1: First-principles logical derivation of specifications. Phase 2: Expert validation against domain knowledge. Phase 3: Empirical tuning based on ranked-table usage feedback.
